headline: H100 SXM index rises +7% over 7 days to $4.62 while other GPUs hold flat.
bullets: H100 SXM was the only GPU to move this week, up +7% to a $4.62 index across 12 providers, with hyperscalers at $10.68 versus $4.25 at neoclouds.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +151%, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at $2.69.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, ahead of B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers offer MI300X.
B200 indexes at $8.50 with a +77% hyperscaler premium, the narrowest of any GPU, and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a $2.70 index, with Vast.ai offering it at $1.10.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM increase holds or spreads to H200, currently indexed at $5.40 with a +95% hyperscaler premium.
